title: probeLine
body:
## probeLine

Samples the input's point and cell arrays along the segment from start to end (Plot Over Line), interpolating within cells, and outputs a polyline with the sampled arrays plus arc_length and vtkValidPointMask (1 where a sample lies inside the data). Use it for spatial profiles, e.g. velocity across a channel. ParaView's XML default sampling pattern is uniform, for which resolution (Schemaxis default 100) is the number of intervals.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Samples outside the mesh have vtkValidPointMask 0 and placeholder values; mask them before plotting or measuring.
- Sampling behaviour follows the native PlotOverLine settings; resolution controls the uniform-sampling mode.

Native constructor: `PlotOverLine`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | First endpoint as [X, Y, Z], in the same world-coordinate system as the dataset. Use preview bounds to locate it. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[-1,0,0]` | `[-1,0,0]` |
| `end` | Second endpoint as [X, Y, Z]. Choose a different point from the start to define a nonzero line. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[1,0,0]` | `[1,0,0]` |
| `resolution` | Number of intervals when PlotOverLine uses uniform sampling. Native sampling-pattern settings determine how samples are actually placed. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1}` | `100` | `100` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "probeLine",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
